title: Portal Chats on the phone: swipe a conversation for quick tools
text: On your phone, swipe a conversation in Portal Chats to the right to mark it read or unread and to pin it. Swipe it to the left to make a note or copy its link. Scrolling up and down works as before, and the computer is unchanged.
points: Swipe right: Read / Unread and Pin / Unpin
Swipe left: Note and Copy link
Tap an open row to close it; tap a closed row to open the chat

steps.name: Swipe a conversation right
steps.detail: Read / Unread and Pin / Unpin appear under it.

steps.name: Swipe it left
steps.detail: Note and Copy link appear under it.

steps.name: Press a button
steps.detail: It does the action and the row closes.
